faq.q: o I need to have any experience to parasail?
faq.a: Absolutely not! You don’t need experience to fly. If you can sit, you can fly! What are the age restrictions for parasailing? There is no age limit for parasailing, however we do not encourage children under the age of 2 to ride on the boat. Are reservations recommended? Reservations are REQUIRED. Boats fill up quickly during the summer season. All you need to make a reservation is a major credit card. What is your cancellation policy? Cancellations may be made no less than 24 hours prior to you
